notes.title: Hotfix for 2 locked achievements
notes.content:
This quick update fixes a bug that prevented two achievements ("Legacy Retained" and "Mob Justice") from being awarded when they should have been.

This explains why only my personal Steam account had these unlocked. I'm not bragging, and I'm definitely not proud of it -- mistakes happen, but I'm committed to fixing everything. Eventually. :)

Cheers,
Sandor

notes.title: Game Update: v1.3 out now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904297/7cb0394439378d0b21456672483ae2fbf2f8aff6.png

Among minor, user experience-related improvements, like showing a reminder if you forget to use teleport-swaps in Showdowns, the version 1.3 of Words of Yendor introduces a new variation to hangman puzzles, encountered at Suspicious Accidents.

Starting from the 4th settlements, instead of trying to guess just a single word, an almost randomly selected verse from a 19th century poem will have to be solved. But, be careful, in these puzzles a tier-1 letter (the most common letters in English words) can only be submitted as guess after making 2 successful guesses with a higher tier letter.

For example, in a 4th, 5th, or 6th settlement a Suspicious Accident might start like this:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904297/b34e2aaa60f45b53750e7b6edd87011e63a0e696.png
Notice while you can see the word distributions, none of the letters are revealed at the start and you only have 3 opportunities for a miss before your health suffers. The purple lock icons indicate that tier-1 letters are not available at the moment, but you'll also get a reminder as tooltips.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904297/2fcca60a4aed31e347a81779c09fe6646525993b.png
Here, after successfully submitting H and L, a single opportunity to submit a tier-1 letter was unlocked, and the choice of E has revealed some useful hints.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904297/e5f2a21a58eb157f060e2e8c599a5440584b497c.png
Finally, the verse was successfully solved, and the poem's title and author were also shown.

Since there are more than 3200 verses in the game's database, you'll encounter some inspiring, poignant, or thought-provoking lines, and in every case, the solution will reveal the poem's title and author.

I hope you'll enjoy this variation in these puzzles.

Cheers,
Sandor

notes.title: Game Update: v1.2: New encounter, new equipable, tactical scouting and more!
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce the release of version 1.2 of Words of Yendor.

This free, automatic update features:
New encounter: "Hello, Dear Creature – Compassion from unexpected, unassuming sources."
New equipable: "Surveyor Goggle" – Predicting scouting failure consequences for the entire settlement.
Tactical scouting: Some tiles now provide extra effects to make scouting more interesting.
Enhanced consistency:Lighting a candle in a Shrine guarantees the removal of all curses. Previously, each curse was evaluated separately.
All dowsing-related equipables now explicitly report when they have been activated. Previously, some encounters silently applied these bonuses.
Rewards for Suspicious Accident are now calculated with reduced reliance on chance.UX improvement:Added a button in Word Log that opens the Wiktionary web page for the selected word.
Scouted encounters are now indicated with directional arrows to make the hero’s location more prominent.Minor visual adjustments.
Minor game balance-related adjustments.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904297/ab758927a76d3ba2093473c46b948a24ac49b922.png

notes.title: Game Update: v1.1 out now!
notes.content:
The v1.1 update implements game balance adjustments and generic improvements for the user experience.

Showdowns are now (optionally) less cruel. As you know, in this puzzle, each letter swap costs some of your accumulated Experience and Clues points. Once any of these runs out, the price for each swap is the loss of 1 Health. Since this update, while your Health is below the half of its maximum, you'll also receive a teleport-swap charge to give you an extra chance to complete these puzzles.
Scouting: An icon reminds you of the risk (or the lack of it) of failure in Scouting puzzles. This is the same icon you see in the top left corner of the encounter cards.
Assassins: They are still quite deadly, but their defense has been reduced.
Screensaves (shortcut: F11) filenames now contain the length of the Word along with the adventure seed; the screensaves can be found in the data directory, accessible from the Main Menu's top left corner.
Various bug fixes and adjustments for minor visual glitches.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904297/4279f8f429957ef6459356f7bb11ac82e6afaa1f.png

notes.title: Announcing beta v1.1: "Showdown Revamped" -- available now for all
notes.content:
Some players have shared their love for Words of Yendor, but some found the Showdown puzzles too hard. Indeed, balancing a game is an art, as players sometimes seek a tough challenge, but sometimes they just want to relax.

I'm proudly announcing a solution: a new feature has been activated to make Showdowns more approachable. As you know, when a Showdown proves too tough and you run out of Experience and Clues points for swaps, the adventurer will have to pay 1 Health per swap instead. Thanks to the new feature, when your Health drops below half of its Maximum, you'll receive a teleport-swap charge as a compensation for each such Health loss. As a reminder, a teleport-swap allows you to swap any two letters on the board, so they don't have to be next to each other.

I'd appreciate your feedback on this game-altering patch before I publish the updated game for everyone.

To ensure this change aligns with your preferences, a beta branch have been created, so you can check out the revamped Showdown. You can now choose which version you wish to play on Steam: the original version or the beta version with the altered Showdown. You can switch between the versions at any time, but please note that saved games are version-specific.

To switch between versions, follow these steps:
 Open the Steam desktop application.
 Go to "Library."
 In the left sidebar, find "Words of Yendor" and right-click.
 Select "Properties."
 Choose "Betas" from the left sidebar.
 Select "beta - Testing the next version" from the "Beta Participation" dropdown.
 Steam will automatically download and switch to the v1.1 build.
 You can switch back to the main public version (v1.0) by selecting "None" in the "Beta Participation" dropdown.
 You can check the version number on the Credits screen.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904297/373d451b23e38f0ad3a44d2df3332934baf58c32.png

I believe this change significantly enhances the user experience without any drawbacks.

Your feedback is crucial; please share your thoughts.

Best regards,
Sandor, the designer/developer of Words of Yendor

notes.title: Small, but meaningful update
notes.content:
Thanks to player suggestions, this update introduces a small but meaningful change that improves the gameplay experience for everyone.

Each encounter card has an icon in the top left corner that indicates what happens if scouting that encounter fails. Either there is no negative consequence, or the encounter card becomes inaccessible at that location, or, it might happen that the encounter automatically activates, which can be dangerous.

Until now, these icons were only visible for encounters that have already been scouted. But with this update, these icons are always visible:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43904297/691a4406683574db802d986b9d88f4e8525f80fd.png

So, it's no longer a gamble to decide if there is a serious risk to scouting, or the worst that can happen is that you don't get more Clues or maybe miss out on an extra encounter option. However, if you already have a revealed encounter that looks acceptable, and you are facing an unscouted encounter that is probably hard to scout and is indicated to be dangerous, you might just keep playing it safe.
